concentration_time_figure.note: The rat parameter values are not restated numerically in the body text.

notes: PEPlife2's value of 0.9 h could NOT be verified numerically: the body describes the rat profile only qualitatively - 'short terminal half-lives and moderate ... volumes of distribution typical for a small conjugate' - and does not restate the rat number. It is consistent with that description and is left uncorrected. Unlike the carrier-plus-payload records excluded elsewhere in this cohort, BT8009 is retained: the quantified species is the CONJUGATE itself, a 4.2 kDa bicyclic peptide covalently bearing MMAE, and the paper reports unconjugated MMAE separately and at low levels. So the label does describe the peptide entity. SEQUENCE ENCODING: the stored string carries four non-natural residue codes (1Nal, dC, HArg, HyP) and omits the sarcosine decamer spacer, the valine-citrulline cleavable linker and MMAE - together a large fraction of a 4.2 kDa molecule. No dose, route, strain or group size is given for the rat PK in the body.
